subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the reported generated-doc gap, while two open PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different proof and implementation signals.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and preserving its formatter/test coverage.

options.title: Repair same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves conflicts, derives annotations from metadata, and adds current-head proof.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and preserving its formatter/test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original SecretRef coverage PR and has recent stabilization history on the credential matrix docs surface.
